name: the Minpentai arenas inside the mountain pyramids
about: The dark game halls inside the mountain pyramids where Minpentai matches are played: Pafogai Du's (chapters 4 and 7) and the much larger one in the capital (chapters 12 and 14). The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.
